plugins.name: matrix-bridge
plugins.description: Connect ZCode to Matrix as an autonomous 24/7 bot: direct homeserver sync, per-room workspace bindings, thread sub-sessions, admin whitelists, invite/message policies and federation privacy guards.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 将 ZCode 以原生 Bot 身份 24/7 接入 Matrix：直连 Homeserver 同步、按房间绑定工作区、Thread 独立子会话、管理员白名单、邀请/消息准入与联邦隐私防护；聊天消息调度到无头 zcode 会话。
